name: BRE_ANI_AreaCode_Template
description:
This simple flow plays a message and queues the caller. 
For more information, refer to the detailed guide: 

https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n5595zd/Webex-Contact-Center-Setup-and-Administration-Guide#Cisco_Generic_Topic.dita_e338e055-64b0-4973-bd52-8a5581dcb0ee

properties.description: Welcomes the customer
properties.connector:name: Cisco Cloud Text-to-Speech
properties.name: WelcomePrompt

properties.description: Queues the call to the dynamic Queue ID that is stored in the lookup
properties.fallbackQueue:name: Q_arubhatt
properties.name: Queue
properties.destination:name: Q_arubhatt

properties.description: Plays Music in Queue while caller is on hold
properties.name: Music
properties.prompt:name: defaultmusic_on_hold.wav

properties.description: Comfort Message for waiting in the queue.
properties.connector:name: Cisco Cloud Text-to-Speech
properties.name: PlayMessage_c24

promptsTts.value: Thank you for your patience. Please wait while we find you an expert.
promptsTts.name: Thank you for your patience. Please wait while we find you an expert.

properties.description: Collect the lookup type from the customer.
properties.connector:name: Cisco Cloud Text-to-Speech
properties.name: EnterLookup

promptsTts.value: We're looking up your information. Please press 1 for Lookup by ANI.
promptsTts.name: We're looking up your information. Please press 1 for Lookup by ANI.

properties.name: SetLookupKey1
properties.description: Sets the lookup to the ANI

properties.name: SetLookupKey2
properties.description: Sets the lookup to the DNIS

properties.name: SetLookupKey3
properties.description: Sets the lookup to the Area Code

properties.name: SetTable
properties.description: sets the lookup table to ANILookup. This table has to be created and configured on the BRE Datasync.

properties.name: BRERequest_6vy
properties.description:
Executes the lookup - this is the main BRE request. 
It looks up the table (context) with the key that you have stored.

properties.name: SetTable2
properties.description: sets the lookup table to DNISLookup. This table has to be created and configured on the BRE Datasync.

properties.name: SetTable3
properties.description: sets the lookup table to AreaCodeLookup. This table has to be created and configured on the BRE Datasync.

properties.name: Condition_yvw
properties.description: Checks whether the lookup resolved correctly or not.
Plays message that it cannot locate information
properties.connector:name: Cisco Cloud Text-to-Speech
properties.name: PlayMessage_kzj

promptsTts.value: We're sorry, we could not locate your information. We are connecting you to the next available agent.
promptsTts.name: We're sorry, we could not locate your information. We are connecting you to the next available agent.

properties.description: Plays message that we located the caller information
properties.connector:name: Cisco Cloud Text-to-Speech
properties.name: PlayMessage_owy

promptsTts.value: Great! We just found your information. You will now be queued to an Agent.
promptsTts.name: Great! We just found your information. You will now be queued to an Agent.
